contextualAIReview: Measurement conditions describe the published electrical load/input/tone setup; source is attribution URL; applying correction is conditional on the actual setup matching. Imported content is preserved rather than translated.
newSources: Apply only if these conditions match your system.
preservation: Shared display helpers add FSI/PDI to supplied names/conditions and LRI/PDI to URL/filter text only when rendering. Imported profile identifiers, stored values and JSON fields are unchanged.

linuxTests.scope: 33 locales plus pseudo-locales/regional/shared UI/catalog fixtures. extractionTests.newGate: Every src C++ source/header/adapter receives existing direct-caption validation; a newly added control header cannot bypass it.
